description: This file contains CKEditor 5 plugin code for handling 'mention' functionality, including UI components, command definitions, and configuration for mention suggestions.

classes.name: s

classes.description: UI view class for mention suggestions list.

classes.name: V
classes.description: UI button view class for mention items.

classes.name: R
classes.description: UI list item class for mention suggestions.

classes.name: S

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Checks if mention attribute can be applied in current selection.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Inserts a mention at the current selection or specified range.

methods.description: Initializes the mention editing plugin, sets up schema, conversions, and post-fixers.

methods.description: Creates the mention suggestions list view.

methods.description: Retrieves the renderer for mention suggestion items.

methods.description: Requests mention suggestions feed based on input text.

methods.description: Handles the response of mention suggestions feed.
